searches.note: Twenty three searches of twenty eight, five unspent. Searches blocked the author's own domains where an independent second source was wanted, and two searches read the house's own domain. No WebFetch was tried.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: founding, people and dates, grapes, sites, making, label words, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules.
Where a search contradicted the record it was set right with its source; where a detail stood in one source or none it was cut or hedged.

swaps.ruling: No swap proposed by the author. Angel Flower stands over Earth Smoke: both are foundation blocks, the plan names Angel Flower and nothing read ranks either above the other. Netherwood Chardonnay stands for Black Estate under the plan; the house's own page makes Netherwood its oldest site.

codexTension: The region record's summary calls Pegasus Bay the house to know and dates the Canterbury Plains industry to 1978; the record's founder's vineyard of 1976 is told as the house's claim and does not contradict it, but the read-together agent may note the two years side by side.
The region record's producers line does not list Pyramid Valley, Greystone or Black Estate; reported, not edited.
planWhys: Pegasus Bay's why: planted in the mid 1980s with a first vintage in 1991 stands; the Riesling confirmed as the house's centre.
Bell Hill's why: planted from 1997 on limestone stands.
